segments.text: Yagami Coco's dog.

A robot dog that Coco owns. In the Remake, she was created by Tanaka Youichi and designated LM-QSS17. Akanegasaki Sora describes PiPi as her "younger sister," and the two share the same computer/body after the 2017 incident.
Tanaka Yubiseiharukana's father, who disappeared in 2000.
Yagami Coco's father.

Izumi and Kurumi's father, the world-famous authority on genetic engineering. A man who participated in the Human Genome Project, a project with the goal to clarify the whole particulars of humans by analyzing the genomes they possessed. He made striking results on said project.
(Never7)
He used cloning techniques at a time where cloning was still illegal to create Kurumi's clone ― Haruka.
(Ever17)

He met Yubiseiharukana by chance when she was suffering from a severe heart disease and was on the verge of despair, and perhaps because he has two daughters close to her age, they eventually developed a father-daughter relationship. He convinced You, who had only a short time left to live, to give birth to a clone, and he offered to fully support her.
He has a deep knowledge of both Curé Syndrome and the Curé Virus.
(From the Never7/Ever17 PSP-exclusive TIPS)
Tsugumi's djungarian hamster.

"Kid" is a mysterious character who can't remember who he is or why he's at LeMU. He is introverted, shy, scared, but willing to sacrifice himself for others. Since they don't know his name, the others refer to him as "Kid."
From Walkthrough by Denethor0
His real identity is Kaburaki Ryogo.
Birthday: June 14th, 2001
He is voiced by Hoshi Souichirou, same as his 2034 self.

A university student that has come to LeMU with friends for a day of leisure. He's separated from his friends... and entangled in a horrifying string of events. His personality is usually outgoing, optimistic and sometimes emotional.
From Walkthrough by Denethor0
In the 2034 LeMU incident, Kaburaki Ryogo (the "Kid" of the 2017 incident) takes the role of "Kuranari Takeshi" for a grand plan.
He is 32 years old, but he's physically 20.
Hokuto is Kuranari Takeshi and Komachi Tsugumi's son from their relationship during the year 2017 LeMU incident. He is also Matsunaga Sara's twin brother.
In the 2034 incident he takes the role of "Kid" albeit unintentionally.

A university student that has come to LeMU with friends for a day of leisure. He's separated from his friends...and entangled in a horrifying string of events. His personality is usually outgoing, optimistic and sometimes emotional.
From Walkthrough by Denethor0
This character is the "Takeshi" of the 2017 LeMU incident. He is the father of both Hokuto and Matsunaga Sara, from his relationship with Komachi Tsugumi.

Coco regularly breaks out in behavior that would be too crazy to be broadcast on TV. Her words and action rock the brains of those that see and hear her. Coco is not especially good at anything and has no special skills or qualities to speak of... but she is proud of her ability to bend spoons. But for all of these reasons, Coco is loved by those around her, impossible to dislike, that may in fact may be her special skill.
From Walkthrough by Denethor0

segments.text: A freshman at Kyumeikan Women's University intending to major in archeology, and a part-time worker at LeMU. Her father gave her this unique first name because Tanaka was a common surname but very rare as a first name. She also possesses a wealth of occult-related knowledge and skills to survive in an emergency. More than anything, she loves to talk. Her nickname is "You."
From Walkthrough by Denethor0

She is the young "Tanaka You" in 2017 LeMU incident and the grown-up "Dr. Tanaka" in the 2034 LeMU incident. By 2034, she is 35 years old but physically 23 years old, and she is pretending to be her own mother, "Tanaka Yukie."

segments.text: A freshman at Kyumeikan Women's University intending to major in archeology, and a part-time worker at LeMU. Her father gave her this unique first name because Tanaka was a common surname but very rare as a first name. She also possesses a wealth of occult-related knowledge and skills to survive in an emergency. More than anything, she loves to talk. Her nickname is "You."
From Walkthrough by Denethor0
She is the young "Tanaka You" in 2034 LeMU incident and the daughter/clone of the original "Tanaka You" (You'haru') of the 2017 LeMU incident.
A girl of few words, shrouded in mystery. Why has she come to LeMU?

Who, or what, is she? Her cold eyes seem as though they can peer right into the hearts of people and she regularly has harsh words for others. Just when it appears that she might open up, she lets loose with a flood of anger. What is the secret that this strange girl possesses?
From Walkthrough by Denethor0
Her body is eternally 17, but in 2017 she is 23 years old, and in 2034 she is 40 years old. In 2017 she, with Kuranari Takeshi, conceived the twins Hokuto and Matsunaga Sara.

Sara is a second year student at Kyumeikan Girl's High School. Before graduating, Tanaka You was also a student there and Sara's senpai. She may not look it, but she is an experienced hacker, capable of breaking into nearly any computer system. Sara is also obsessed with ninja and ninjutsu.
Sara came to LeMU on a class field trip, but now she is stranded along with the other characters.
From Wikipedia
She is the daughter of Komachi Tsugumi and Kuranari Takeshi, from their relationship in 2017, and Hokuto's younger twin sister.
The only full-time staff member of LeMU to be stranded, Sora is a professional computer engineer,
as well as the main AI. Although she is an AI, she can think on her own, as
she tries her best to get everyone stranded on LeMU to safety.
She thinks rationally at all times, not allowing emotions to sway her decisions.
She is programmed to act 24 years old.
She likes flowers, animals, and anything living in nature.
From Wikipedia
Her official designation is LM-RSDS-4913A in the original, and LM-QS16 in the remake.

A metafictional entity that provides a bird's-eye view of the events of the game world without being tied to a timeline, almost like the player himself. Several characters communicate with the BW and, by borrowing its perspective, are capable of timeless perception. Coco is the representative of the group, often making cryptic statements because she knows the future.
It can travel through the three spacial dimensions and the time dimension,
he overlaps his consciousness with Hokuto and is the real mastermind behind the "accident" of 2034.
